name: X Select
author: AmberX AXF
description: Adds Read aloud (and optionally Read slowly, Read next, Spell it out) to the text selection menu next to Select all in every app on the phone. Settings-only screen with a toolbar, a live banner and an axHub status badge on the app's banner; 80+ settings with wide ranges (voice, engine, language, speed 0.1–4×, pitch, volume, left/right, pauses, link/emoji/number/markdown cleanup, pronunciations, chunking, queue, repeat, audio focus, notification controls, sleep timer, feedback).
